quotations.old_english: Wé lǽraþ ðæt ǽnig forþboren preóst ne forseó ðone læsborenan
quotations.english: we enjoin that any highborn priest do not despise the one of inferior birth

source_text: læs-boren; adj. Of inferior birth :-- Wé lǽraþ ðæt ǽnig forþboren preóst ne forseó ðone læsborenan we enjoin that any highborn priest do not despise the one of inferior birth, L. Edg. C. 13; Th. ii. 246, 21.
